acceptanceCriteria: a chore planning only manifest-listed files advances with no tests or proofs
a chore planning a file the manifest does not list still owes every gate
a missing or tampered manifest falls back to the fixed manifest-owned set
diagnosis: Reproduce: a chore task with files.allow AGENTS.md and .claude/** (both listed in .codictator/manifest.json) at planning; task phase next fails CDX-E604 declared tests, red proof. Root cause: classifyChange in features/workflow/writes.ts hard-codes package.json, package-lock.json, .nvmrc and .codictator/.githooks/.husky prefixes and assumes that set is all of SPEC 4.14.1 manifest-owned; the manifest-listed paths are never consulted, so isManifestChore in phases.ts is false for regen output. SPEC matches intent; code is narrower.
